verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents assigning preset or custom roles to members, which override base roles, and scoping API tokens to restrict the operations they can perform. The evidence never shows permissions scoped to specific flags or environments, so the 'which flags' part of the story is only implied. Missing for 10: documented per-flag/per-environment resource-level policy scoping, detail on the custom role policy language, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens

citations.quote: If a member is directly assigned a role, such as a preset role or a role that you create, that role is used instead of the member's base role
You can scope your API tokens to restrict the set of operations they can perform. For example, you can build an integration that only has read access
